title: Introduction
body_text:
Thank you for participating to this experiment.

You will have to perform a series of tasks which will consist in identyfing patterns in images. Your goal is to maximize your performance, by trying to provide the right answer for every image. Your bonus financial reward will depend on your overall performance during the main experimental phase.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions
